title: How big will Leonida really be?
text: Rockstar has shown Vice City, the Keys and the swamps. How big do you think the full map is compared to Los Santos and Blaine County? Bigger is not always better, so what size would be perfect for you?

title: GTA Online after GTA 6
text: What do you expect from the next GTA Online? Should it start fresh, or should players keep anything from GTA V Online?

title: Lucia and Jason's ending
text: The trailers lean hard into a Bonnie and Clyde story. Do you think it ends well for both of them? What kind of ending would you want?

title: Interiors everywhere?
text: How many buildings do you think we can enter? Shops, apartments, malls? What interior are you hoping for most?

title: Story DLC is coming back?
text: GTA IV had big story expansions, GTA V never got one. Do you think Rockstar will make story DLC for GTA 6, and what should it be about?

title: The social media world in Leonida
text: The trailers are full of phone videos and viral clips. How do you think the in-game social media will work? Will it react to what we do?

title: Old characters returning?
text: Do you expect cameos from earlier GTA characters in Leonida? Who would you want to see, and who should stay retired?

title: How smart will the police be?
text: Should the police in GTA 6 be smarter and more realistic, or should they stay arcade-style fun? Where is the line for you?

title: Weather and hurricanes
text: Florida has storms, floods and hurricanes. Do you think Rockstar will use dynamic weather events, and would you want them to change the map?

title: The radio in GTA 6
text: Vice City in 2002 had one of the best soundtracks ever. What kind of stations and artists do you hope for this time?

title: Wildlife in the swamps
text: Alligators are already confirmed in the trailers. What other animals do you think we will run into, and will hunting or fishing be part of the game?

title: Day one PC version?
text: GTA 6 launches on consoles first. When do you think the PC version will come, and will you wait for it or play on console?

title: Missions you hope for
text: If you could design one heist or mission for GTA 6, what would it look like? Bank, yacht, airport, something totally new?

title: How long should the story be?
text: GTA V's story took most people around 30 to 40 hours. How long should GTA 6's story be, and is longer always better?

title: Easter eggs and mysteries
text: GTA V had the Mount Chiliad mystery. What kind of secret or mystery do you hope Rockstar hides in Leonida?

title: Vice City then and now
text: What do you think Rockstar keeps from the Vice City of 2002, and what will feel completely new in the modern version?

title: Car customization
text: How deep should car customization go in GTA 6? Is GTA V's level enough, or do you want something closer to a racing game?

title: Property and businesses
text: Do you want to buy houses and run businesses in story mode, like in Vice City 2002? Which business would you buy first?

title: What should never change?
text: Every GTA has things that just feel like GTA. What is the one thing Rockstar must never change?

title: What could go wrong?
text: Expectations are huge. What is your biggest worry about GTA 6, and what would make you disappointed?

title: First week impressions
text: You have been in Leonida for a few days now. What surprised you most, good or bad? No big story spoilers, please.

title: Hidden details you found
text: Share the smallest detail that blew your mind in GTA 6 so far. Screenshots welcome, spoilers in spoiler tags.

title: What should the first update add?
text: Now that GTA 6 is out, what is the first thing Rockstar should add or fix in an update?
